meta.scope: Base-game 159 bazaar decorations. DLC-only additions excluded, item provenance tracked by GameWith list index.
scope_exclusions: cosmetic costumes not usable as Bazaar decor
meta.naming: name_ja is the Japanese title reported by GameWith; name_en is a separate StratsWiki title and should not be used as an ID. IDs are stable strings derived from English labels, or verified Japanese rosette names.
meta.source_policy: Official manual governs tent-series activation. StratsWiki enumerates 159 base decorations, effects and levels. GameWith provides Japanese labels and item acquisition. StratsWiki Rebecca inventory validates price/rank where it agrees; disagreements stay explicit.
meta.discovery_policy: Never enumerate undiscovered decor items, series members, acquisition requirements or bonuses in the client. Player inventory/installation/discovery live exclusively in Player State.
audit_flags: 5-item Cheer Gauge bonus: StratsWiki=10% vs kokorogu=20%, numeric value unresolved.
GameWith lists honey balloons as Bug series; StratsWiki lists them as Forager. Preserve conflict; do not assert set bonus from these items as verified.
Egg Tower base price GameWith=21,000G vs StratsWiki Rebecca=2,100G; leave numeric price unresolved.
Seasonal trend wagons GameWith=4,800,000G vs kokorogu=5,600,000G; leave numeric price unresolved.
Several windmill decor material recipes differ between GameWith and StratsWiki; craft recipes deferred to separately verified table.
English/Japanese cooking utensil decoration grades have different label wording; grade linked by effect level, never a translated adjective.
Challenger Beetle Battle Toy reward location: GameWith cites Kagetsu, StratsWiki cites Lloyd, but canonical Request Master reward for Kagetsu is mushroom spores. Do not auto-link.

rules.placement_rule: Only placed (not merely owned) decoration items contribute effects.
rules.tentative_rank_slot_limit_note: Total slots increase as Bazaar rank rises, maximum 11 at rank 6 (kokorogu). Exact intermediate slot increments are not modeled.
